observations: An initial repair intake phrased with ‘不能’ was routed as support by the existing classifier; the successful exercise used explicit new-feature wording. Generic classification was outside this slice.
The zero-model trial exercised the common source registration, queue/start and Worker backfill with deterministic adapters. It does not measure model performance.

notice.text: 维修报价查看页已可以内部试用：http://127.0.0.1:8808/?quote=R101 。请分别用两位客户账号打开自己的报价，再让另一位客户打开这条链接，确认看不到金额或项目。最后由店员撤回报价，请原客户刷新或重新打开旧链接。试完请在这个会话告诉我们结果。
